description: This PHP source file defines a database migration class for version 4.9.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to create and modify database tables related to themes, permissions, menu items, and event queues, as well as inserting default data.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration to handle database schema updates for OrangeHRM version 4.9.0, including creating tables, inserting data, and updating schema.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema updates, including creating tables, adding columns, inserting default data, and cleaning up marketplace addons.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.9' for this migration.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert a menu item into the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: insertTheme
methods.description: Helper method to insert a theme into the database if it does not already exist.
